ChatApproval.description:
A tool call of a manual-mode turn waits for the user's decision (chat.approve). args are
the call's validated arguments: model-chosen data, to be shown as text only. After
expires_at the call is refused as expired.
ChatApproval.title: ChatApproval

ChatApproveParams.description:
The decision on a chat.approval of a turn of this connection. rest_of_turn (approve only):
every later tool call of the same turn runs without asking.
ChatApproveParams.title: ChatApproveParams

ChatStartParams.description:
chat.send with a permission mode. manual: before each tool call of the turn runs, the
daemon sends chat.approval and waits for chat.approve; bypass: tool calls run without asking,
as with chat.send. Neither lifts the per-action approval of W2/W3 tools.
ChatStartParams.title: ChatStartParams

SearchHit.description: Same shape as the `search_messages` tool output (architecture §5).
SearchHit.title: SearchHit

ToolCallError.description: A refused or failed tool call: content-free code, reason and message.
ToolCallError.title: ToolCallError

ToolCallParams.description: client_name is a display label for the audit log only, never an id.
ToolCallParams.title: ToolCallParams

ToolCallResult.description: ok: output is set and error is absent; not ok: error is set and output is absent.
ToolCallResult.title: ToolCallResult

ToolList.description:
Each entry is a tern-tool/1 tool metadata document; tools with a forbidden effect are not
listed.
ToolList.title: ToolList
